Series Finale at Newlands

The third and final men's Test match between South Africa and Australia reaches its fifth and final day at Newlands in Cape Town, with the series level and all to play for in a winner-take-all contest.

Play is scheduled to begin at 10:30 am local time (8:30 am GMT / 7:30 pm AEDT). The match format follows standard Test cricket rules over five days.

Match Situation and Targets

According to reports from the venue, Australia enters the final day needing a target of 288 runs to win the match and the series. South Africa requires 10 wickets to secure victory.

  • Venue: Newlands, Cape Town
  • Target for Australia: 288 runs
  • Bowling Requirement for South Africa: 10 wickets
  • Weather Status: Fine conditions reported, making a draw unlikely unless a batting collapse occurs.

Previous Day Summary

Play on the fourth day saw a significant shift in momentum. Source reports indicated that South Africa built a strong position through notable batting performances, setting up the 288-run target after facing early pressure in the match.

Analysts covering the fixture noted that batting conditions at Newlands presented challenges, featuring significant turn for spinners alongside the pace attack. The outcome remains open as Australia begins their run chase.

Readers can check official cricket boards and sports broadcasting networks, such as Cricket South Africa, Cricket Australia, or ICC channels, for live scorecards, session updates, and confirmed match results.
